title: Cowgirl Cabana *Broadway, Downtown Nashville*
description: Aloha! Welcome to the Cowgirl Cabana where you will experience the perfect mix of Coastal and Cowgirl! Just a 5 minute walk to the neon lights of Broadway as well as a 5 minute walk to the Bridgestone Arena, and a 3 minute walk to the Music City Center! We offer a beautiful, safe, and fun spot for you and all your favorite people to make memories and take on the city! Take advantage of the included access to our heated resort pool, amazing sky lounge, and gym! Enjoy your cute and fun stay!!
